metaTitle: PDO Threads - The Non-Surgical Facelift - Victory Medical Services & Medical Spa

blocks.html: When browsing the celebrity gossip websites, we often see beautiful faces that look unaffected by aging. Many older celebrities have undergone a facelift and the results are impressive. This procedure can take many years off one’s appearance and the results are long-lasting. However, the healing process can be painful, and you can be stuck with swelling, bruising, and other not so pretty results that happen when a surgery goes wrong. Knowing this, many people who educate themselves on the different options will often forego the surgical facelift and elect for PDO threads instead.

PDO threads are known as the non-surgical facelift. The process consists of inserting PDO threads into different areas of the face in order to lift and tighten areas such as the neck, jaws, and cheeks. Hypodermic needles are loaded with an absorbable suture and are they are placed in the areas needing that extra lift. After a period of 4-6 months the sutures will be absorbed by the body and never have to be removed. The PDO threads are composed of a material that has been used extensively for years by surgeons and are deemed an extremely safe material. And even better, there are no scars left after the procedure.

Many people think that the threads are used to pull up and tighten the skin, but this isn’t the case. The threads work by creating a response in the area that they are used, and the body produces more collagen and elastin around the threads. This leaves your skin appearing smoother, healthier, and more firm.

blocks.text: How Long Do PDO Threads Last?

blocks.html: The threads last for 4-6 months until the body absorbs them, but the effects will last much longer as the body continues to build collagen and elastin in the areas where they were placed. Many experience continued results for an additional 3-6 months after the PDO threads are absorbed by the body.

blocks.text: What Should You Do After a PDO Thread Lift?

blocks.html: Avoid alcohol for 7 days to avoid bruising. It is also important to avoid temperature extremes such as a sauna or cold climates for a week and a half. Ideally, once should also avoid exercise for 7 days post procedure.
